description: provides AI-powered PostgreSQL performance tuning capabilities.  https://github.com/isdaniel/pgtuner_mcp

tool_signatures.name: action
tool_signatures.description: Action to perform - progress (monitor active vacuum operations), needs_vacuum (find tables needing vacuum), autovacuum_status (review autovacuum configuration), or recent_activity (view recent vacuum history)

tool_signatures.name: analysis_type
tool_signatures.description: Type of I/O analysis - all (comprehensive), buffer_pool (cache hit ratios), tables (table I/O patterns), indexes (index I/O patterns), temp_files (temporary file usage), or checkpoints (checkpoint I/O statistics)

tool_signatures.name: analyze
tool_signatures.description: Execute query with EXPLAIN ANALYZE

tool_signatures.name: analyze_disk_io_patterns
tool_signatures.description: Analyze disk I/O read/write patterns, identify hot tables, buffer cache efficiency, and I/O bottlenecks. Supports filtering by analysis type (all, buffer_pool, tables, indexes, temp_files, checkpoints).

tool_signatures.name: analyze_index_bloat
tool_signatures.description: Analyze B-tree index bloat using pgstatindex. Shows leaf density, fragmentation, and empty/deleted pages. Also supports GIN and Hash indexes.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_query
tool_signatures.description: Analyze a query's execution plan with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, including automated issue detection

tool_signatures.name: analyze_table_bloat
tool_signatures.description: Analyze table bloat using pgstattuple extension. Shows dead tuple counts, free space, and wasted space percentage.

tool_signatures.name: analyze_wait_events
tool_signatures.description: Analyze wait events to identify I/O, lock, or CPU bottlenecks. Focuses on client backend processes.

tool_signatures.name: buffers
tool_signatures.description: Include buffer statistics

tool_signatures.name: check_database_health
tool_signatures.description: Comprehensive health check with scoring (connections, cache, locks, replication, wraparound, disk, checkpoints)

tool_signatures.name: explain_with_indexes
tool_signatures.description: Run EXPLAIN with hypothetical indexes to test improvements without creating real indexes

tool_signatures.name: find_unused_indexes
tool_signatures.description: Find unused and duplicate indexes that can be safely dropped

tool_signatures.name: format
tool_signatures.description: Output format - json, text, yaml, xml

tool_signatures.name: get_active_queries
tool_signatures.description: Monitor active queries, find long-running transactions and blocked queries. By default excludes system processes.

tool_signatures.name: get_bloat_summary
tool_signatures.description: Get a comprehensive overview of database bloat with top bloated tables/indexes, total reclaimable space, and priority maintenance actions.

tool_signatures.name: get_index_recommendations
tool_signatures.description: AI-powered index recommendations based on query workload analysis

tool_signatures.name: get_slow_queries
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve slow queries from pg_stat_statements with detailed stats (total time, mean time, calls, cache hit ratio). Excludes system catalog queries.

tool_signatures.name: get_table_stats
tool_signatures.description: Get detailed table statistics including size, row counts, dead tuples, and access patterns

tool_signatures.name: include_hypothetical_testing
tool_signatures.description: Test with HypoPG

tool_signatures.name: include_recommendations
tool_signatures.description: Include actionable recommendations

tool_signatures.name: include_toast
tool_signatures.description: Include TOAST table analysis

tool_signatures.name: index_name
tool_signatures.description: Name of a specific index to analyze (optional)

tool_signatures.name: limit
tool_signatures.description: Maximum queries to return

tool_signatures.name: manage_hypothetical_indexes
tool_signatures.description: Create, list, drop, or reset HypoPG hypothetical indexes. Supports hide/unhide existing indexes.

tool_signatures.name: max_recommendations
tool_signatures.description: Maximum recommendations

tool_signatures.name: min_bloat_percent

tool_signatures.name: min_mean_time_ms
tool_signatures.description: Minimum mean (average) execution time in milliseconds filter

tool_signatures.name: min_size_gb
tool_signatures.description: Minimum object size in GB to include

tool_signatures.name: min_size_gb
tool_signatures.description: Minimum object size in GB to include

tool_signatures.name: min_table_size_gb
tool_signatures.description: Minimum table size in GB to include in schema-wide scan

tool_signatures.name: monitor_vacuum_progress
tool_signatures.description: Track manual VACUUM, VACUUM FULL, and autovacuum operations. Monitor progress percentage, dead tuples collected, index vacuum rounds, and estimated time remaining. Includes autovacuum configuration review and tables needing maintenance.
